_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all company facts. Values below are transcribed from the Dubai Commercial License No. 1646635 (issued 20/08/2026). Anything published here must match the trade licence and the D-U-N-S record exactly. Run `node build/build.mjs` after editing.
_needsReview: domain / siteUrl — confirm the registered domain; it must be owned by the company
email.* — these four mailboxes must actually exist on the company domain (Apple will not accept a Gmail address on the enrolment)
dunsNumber — the D&B D-U-N-S field is blank on the trade licence; required for Apple Developer Program enrolment
_basePathNote: Leave empty for a custom domain (the intended setup). Set to "/OceanAstra-Website" only if the site is served from a GitHub project-pages subpath.
_legalNameNote: The licence prints the name in capitals (OCEANASTRA TECHNOLOGIES L.L.C). Rendered here in title case, which is word-for-word identical and reads correctly in running text.
